features.name: a cleanup step names its root cause
features.description: A step that deletes or restarts things to clear a symptom must point to its root cause (feat, issue or PROGRESS entry). Found 2026-10-23: 'delete dead pods' hid hangar's graceful-shutdown bug.
acceptance_criteria: a cleanup step without a cause reference is flagged

acceptance_criteria: a failing check prints reason and message per object; hangar H-001 uses it

features.name: py-guard pip-audit runs; agent-hook checks Codex move targets
features.description: Found by the feat-105 subagent check 2026-10-23. templates/hooks/python/py-guard.sh passes -q to pip-audit, which 2.10.1 rejects (exit 2), so every run with a requirements.txt reports vulnerable deps and blocks: atelier is affected. templates/hooks/common/agent-hook.sh splits a Codex apply_patch per file but skips '*** Move to:' lines, so a broken file renamed in the patch is not checked. Fix both in the template and atelier's (and hangar's) copies.
acceptance_criteria: py-guard runs pip-audit without an unknown flag and blocks only on real findings
a Codex patch moving a broken .sh to a new name is checked and blocked through agent-hook.sh
atelier and hangar copies match the templates outside their config block
features.evidence: Tests first: the Move-to case (test_agent_hook.sh) and a pip-audit stub that rejects -q like 2.10.1 failed on the old templates; 14 and 54 pass after. py-guard now runs pip-audit with --progress-spinner off and blocks only when the output names known vulnerabilities; a run that cannot audit (offline, unresolvable pin) prints SKIP with pip's ERROR line. Real pip-audit 2.10.1: certifi==2026.7.22 gives PYSEC-2026-4320 and exit 1, 2026.10.19 exit 0. agent-hook.sh also passes '*** Move to:' targets to the wrapped hook. Reviews: two subagents (correctness, security), no confirmed defects; they disagreed on blocking when pip-audit fails (fail-closed vs findings only), resolved for the acceptance wording, findings only, and re-reviewed: no confirmed defects. Trade-off kept: one unresolvable pin turns the audit into a visible SKIP for that app. atelier and hangar copies synced after this commit.

features.name: target repos pull harness updates; sync-all writes no tracked files
features.description: Found 2026-10-24: sessions here committed synced hooks inside hangar/atelier main checkouts while their sessions and jobs worked there (10-23 collision; 10-24 ahead 1/behind 1). sync-all keeps only the host-local pack links (ignored via .git/info/exclude); hooks, wiring and the version stamp are no longer written by update.sh or the weekly job. New `harness_adapter.py sync --dry-run <repo>` lists what sync would change, on the same code path as sync. Preflight shows it ('harness behind: N files; run sync here and commit'); the weekly job reports 'behind by N' instead of syncing and alerting on a dirty tree. Replaces hangar's request to commit and push from a throwaway worktree (hangar PROGRESS 'In flight', docs/sessions.md).
acceptance_criteria: update.sh/sync-all leaves a target repo's git status clean (only excluded pack links change)
sync --dry-run lists the same changes sync makes, and writes nothing (fixture test)
preflight in a target that is behind prints the file count and the sync command
the weekly report shows 'behind by N' and no longer flags uncommitted files after a sync
